name: Ratmen
background:
Ratmen are small humanoids, closely related to rats. Individually weak, they rely on large numbers of warriors, growth-serum injected beasts, and inventive war-machines. 

The Ratmen first emerged from the sewer systems beneath the Old Empire’s greatest cities, but were viewed as abominations by the humans and quickly driven out. Faced with many dangers and few friends, the Ratmen have become fanatical warriors and cunning tacticians, often serving as a buffer to the society that drove them out.
backgroundFull:
The Ratmen only started appearing long after humanity and their cities had become widespread throughout much of Tyria. Little is known about how or why they came into being, but they emerged from sewer systems beneath human cities. When their existence was discovered by the humans above, they were viewed as abominations and driven out of the cities. The surviving Ratmen sought refuge in neighbouring lands, but none were willing to accept them. 

The Ratmen eventually found a new home in a stretch of land that had been particularly devastated during the Havoc Wars. In the Northlands, surviving Havoc Warriors continued to raid and plunder, while the original Human inhabitants had mostly moved to the more defended southern regions. The Ratmen settled in these largely abandoned lands, and their numbers rapidly grew as they reclaimed the territory which had been left barren by years of brutal warfare. They rapidly built fortified cities, designed to withstand attack from raiders and any others who might try to claim the Ratmen’s land as their own.

For a time, the Ratmen prospered thanks to their diligent work and the region’s rich natural resources, and soon their society grew prosperous. Within their massive cities, they organised themselves into many guilds, each specialised in providing different benefits for their society, and their cities were ruled by commissions made up of the heads of the city’s key guilds. Yet, as Tyria continued to recover from the Havoc Wars, the Ratmen’s lands fell under increasing pressure from their various neighbours, who sought to reclaim it and forced the Ratmen to endure constant sieges and warfare in order to defend their home. 

The opening of the Rift was the fatal blow to their former society. The rift tore through several cities, destroying their walls, while the forces of Havoc rallied in the north. Panic spread and soon, and the various Guilds were fighting among themselves. 

Just as the forces of Havoc approached their lands, and all hope was lost, a miracle happened. A godly figure of a female rat appeared in the sky and struck down their enemies’ army. The remaining Rats renounced their quarrels and reunited to fight in the name of their mysterious new Goddess, creating a cult in her name that now occupies every corner of their society. Her disciples whisper in the ears of the guild masters, and while many see her as a saviour, others view her as a threat to their still delicate positions. 

How will you serve the Guilds and God-Mother?

product.description: Captain Teibanec is a young, white haired Ratman who dreams of performing heroic deeds and daring stunts. Descended from one the greatest heroes of Brec, who saved the fortified city from invading Daemons, Kedseit can’t help but compare himself to this mighty ancestor. But the time of great battles is long gone, and he has to settle for a dull posting, patrolling the remote edges of the territory. When a band of Daemons of War shows up and their Champion starts threatening him, he jumps at the chance to defend his city’s honour and prove his worth, drawing Havocfall, his legendary sword.

Getrie was a promising new apprentice to the Artificers’ Guild, who quickly rose to the rank of Warlock. She gained the praise and adulation of many within her city until suddenly she hit a creative block. She continued her work where she could, focusing on less glorious work like maintenance and repair. She could not, however, escape the bitter feeling of loss as she saw her star fall and her reputation fade. Then she began to see Moonmire in her dreams. Moonmire’s visions gave Getrie new insight into her creative blocks. For the first time in years, she found her creativity.

product.description: Usually going by Brother Hepalit, Vacnip is a Priest, one of these Ratmen that worship the great God-Mother. His faith is deep, perhaps even deeper than most Priests’. He desires nothing more than to help the God-Mother’s designs come to fruition. When he sees a young, ambitious Captain eager to prove his mettle, Brother Hepalit decides that he must assist him. He deeply believes that their meeting is no accident, and that the God-Mother has plans in store for them. He vows to help Captain Teibanec in his fight against a new Daemonic threat.

specialRules.name: Scurry
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Reinforcement
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken, you may remove it from the table as destroyed. At the beginning of the next round after a unit where all models have this rule is destroyed, after Ambushers have been deployed, you may place a new copy of it fully within 9" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Quick Throw
specialRules.description: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range
specialRules.description: This model gets +6" range when shooting.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ambush Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Evasive Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Evasive. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Counter in melee.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Scurry
specialRules.description: If this model has Scurry, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Scurry (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Enhanced Scurry Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Scurry. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Defense Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Hazardous
specialRules.description: Gets AP(4), but on unmodified results of 1 to hit this model takes one wound, or X wounds if this weapon has the Blast(X)/Deadly(X) rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Agile
specialRules.description: If this model has Agile, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Agile (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Evasive
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (defender picks how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
